It’s an honor to be here with all of you." **Note:** No one will ask. If they do, they’re not part of a true community — and you’d be doing * them* a favor by not overextending yourself. --- ### ❤️ **Final Thought:** Community isn’t about who brings the most food — it’s about ** showing up with an open heart**.
